domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 依据统计谱等表征生成轨道不平顺序列的模型。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道动力计算的轨道不平顺输入构造，将谱特征与概率信息转化为不平顺序列，为系统动力分析提供轨道几何激励。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P002.title: A novel model for determining the amplitude-wavelength limits of track irregularities accompanied by a reliability assessment in railway vehicle-track dynamics
P002.label: Xu等（2017）

complete_examples.text: A track irregularity inversion model is presented to obtain realistic representations of track profile deformations with information regarding amplitudes, wavelengths and probabilities.

To achieve these goals, the probability density evolution method (PDEM) will first be employed, and then, the track irregularity inversion model and the Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method will be further developed.
